big: In India, gold used to mean jewellery. Now more people want gold they can hold without making charges and purity worries. Indian gold ETFs saw record inflows of about ₹43,000 crore in 2025. A habit is shifting.

lines: Why are people buying gold ETFs instead of jewellery?
Jewellery has making charges and purity worries. An ETF tracks the gold price and is bought and sold on the exchange. Global jewellery demand fell to a post-pandemic low of 278 tonnes in Q2 2026.
